scope: Public civilian controlled WLAN experiment; qualify dated capture cohorts and published carrier metadata before any power-only aggregate astronomy observability study. No classifier, deployment or live signal collection.

source.description: Five ESP32 devices transmitting 802.11b beacon signals in controlled chamber and office. Filename prefix is a candidate group token, not authoritative hardware label until metadata/author mapping verified.

INRIA.reason: Official record describes headerless device burst files; archive contains one raw file per device and no independently identified acquisition dates.

temporal.reason: Record expressly restricts raw files; 30 devices, two phases over 67 days, not available for current exam.

WiSig.reason: Four documented capture days; compact subsets overlap, no pickle deserialization.

qualification.unit: Whole environment/day/timestamp session, all devices and all replicate files assigned together; MAT and SigMF representations of same recording not independent.
checks: Verify archive byte length and published MD5, record SHA256
Use SigMF metadata only; verify one-to-one data/meta pair by name, data-size consistency where datatype known, finite center frequency and sampling rate
Parse acquisition timestamps from filename, compare date/time against SigMF capture timestamp if present; report missing or mismatching metadata rather than infer
Record candidate group token counts, unique environment/day/time groups, overlap of labels across dates, frequency and sample rate; reject duplicate data CRC/size or repeated identity across cohorts
Hold until authoritative mapping of filename groups to physical devices and common transmit channel verified; receiver/session independence bounded by publication, no assumption about power cycle.
qualification.candidate_split: Earliest chamber day fit, next chamber day calibration, latest chamber day evaluation; office is separate environment challenge. Require >=3 chamber dates and all five candidate group tokens present in each selected cohort; no choosing groups using power values.
qualification.safe_scope: Only archive directory and bounded SigMF JSON read. No waveform read, feature training, identity models, or operational fingerprints.
qualification.gate: Metadata qualification only. If any device/center-frequency ambiguity remains, HOLD actual examination; freeze separate aggregate power observability protocol before consuming samples.
